subject: evie-emberose
q: Why does Evie have no Nereid profile?
detail:
The Ghost Haven Project Nereid file carries THIRTY-ONE profiles. Ghost Haven has thirty-two residents. The one missing is EVIE EMBEROSE — and her wife Ivy is in there, fully written, gardener and all. Evie is not a thin entry in that document; she is absent from it. Whether the profile was never written, was written into a different file, or was lost, the Archive does not know. She is the only Ghost Haven woman without one.

ANSWERED 7 SEPTEMBER. Viraena delivered the profile whole. See c-evie-filed. RETIRED.
